chiSiamo.title: About us
chiSiamo.description: For more than ten years Mary Lou has been a pastry shop, bar and café in Scalea. The day starts with breakfast: warm croissants, coffee and cappuccino at the counter. Then come the sweets, the small pastries and the cream puffs that fill our display case every day, all made in our own workshop. And for special moments we make cakes to order.
